protocol.support: Only exact forecast leads represented by at least3 distinct prior nights and GFS temperature inside their closed prior range. Otherwise return GFS with an explicit unvalidated-site reason. No current-night measurements or interpolation. Cold outside this support is never claimed calibrated.
protocol.adaptation: Reference metadata identity retains frozen reference prediction. Different positions use GFS unless supported prior local calibration is present. Local bias fits target minus GFS; paired delta fits target minus simultaneously observed reference; residual bias fits target minus prior-fit reference prediction. Shrinkage n/(n+5) or n/(n+20), per exact lead; local calibration uses only previous seasons. No geography-to-temperature law inferred from two sites.
protocol.selection: Baselines gfs/naive_reference are diagnostics. identity_gfs is the default safe transfer policy. Local candidates must improve target-site MAE versus identity_gfs by at least5% in EACH validation year, add no observed-term false-cold predictions or cold misses, and preserve reference predictions exactly. Rank eligible by equal-site/equal-year MAE; tie registry order. If none, retain identity_gfs. No cold-support or production claim inferred from zero observed cold.
protocol.status: Anapa already inspected and now a development site. These are season-forward development folds, NOT unseen-station validation. Candidate registry saved before candidate scoring. No post-result expansion.
protocol.protected: Original detector/point/interval, previous Krymsk and Vityazevo choices remain immutable. No detector execution or new alarm threshold. Reference output unchanged bit-for-bit.
protocol.controls: No2025-2026 download, opening, fit, selection or evaluation
